name: plugin.django_bridge
description: High-leverage Django ecosystem bridge for deep AST project inspection, safe management command execution, declarative model scaffolding, ORM query simulation, template validation, and background tasks introspection.

entrypoints.name: django_inspect_project
entrypoints.description: Deep inspection of a Django project directory: discovers installed apps, models, fields, relations, URL patterns, views, middleware, template loaders, settings, and task queues.

parameters.name: project_path
parameters.description: Path to Django project root directory containing manage.py or settings

parameters.name: settings_module
parameters.description: Optional dotted Python settings module name (e.g. myproject.settings)

parameters.name: include_models
parameters.description: Include detailed model field specifications and relations (default: true)

entrypoints.name: django_manage_exec
entrypoints.description: Execute safe Django management commands (check, showmigrations, migrate --plan, sqlmigrate, diffsettings, inspectdb, makemigrations --dry-run) in a guarded sandbox.

parameters.name: project_path
parameters.description: Path to Django project root directory containing manage.py

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: Safe Django management command to execute

parameters.name: args
parameters.description: Command flags and arguments (e.g. ['--database', 'default', '--plan'])

parameters.name: settings_module
parameters.description: Optional dotted Python settings module override

parameters.name: timeout_sec
parameters.description: Execution timeout in seconds (default: 30.0)

entrypoints.name: django_model_generator
entrypoints.description: Synthesizes declarative Django model classes and fields from JSON/Pydantic schemas or database table specifications.

parameters.name: model_name
parameters.description: PascalCase name of the Django model class (e.g. Article, UserProfile)

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: List of field definitions with name, type (CharField, ForeignKey, etc.), null, blank, related_model

parameters.name: app_label
parameters.description: Target Django app label for the model

parameters.name: docstring
parameters.description: Optional model docstring documentation

parameters.name: meta_options
parameters.description: Django Meta options (db_table, ordering, verbose_name, unique_together)

entrypoints.name: django_query_simulator
entrypoints.description: Evaluates and compiles Django ORM query expressions into formatted SQL queries, parameters, and execution plans without executing destructive database mutations.

parameters.name: query_expr
parameters.description: Django ORM query expression (e.g. Article.objects.filter(is_published=True).select_related('author'))

parameters.name: model_name
parameters.description: Primary model class name being queried

parameters.name: project_path
parameters.description: Optional project path for model schema resolution

entrypoints.name: django_template_validator
entrypoints.description: Validates syntax, tags, template partials ({% partialdef %}), and filter pipelines in Django HTML/DQL templates.

parameters.name: template_content
parameters.description: Raw template HTML/text content to parse and validate

parameters.name: template_path
parameters.description: Optional file path for origin tracking and error reporting

parameters.name: enable_partials
parameters.description: Enable Django 6.x template partial parsing (default: true)

entrypoints.name: django_task_inspector
entrypoints.description: Introspects and verifies Django 6.x background task queues (django.tasks), task signatures, backends, and execution parameters.

parameters.name: project_path
parameters.description: Path to Django project root directory

parameters.name: backend
parameters.description: Optional background task backend to filter (immediate, redis, db)
